sam: Escalating to CS 0% trial blocked: KiteFin cannot provision EU org. UI shows residency error, trial ends in 7 days. Support ticket 112233. @maria pls own. :urgent:

maria: On it. Paste the error? I'll check contract + renewal window.

sam: Error from logs:
```
POST /v1/keys/provision 422
{"error":"residency_mismatch", "requested_region":"eu-west-1", "allowed": ["us-east-1"]}
Ticket 112233
```

ops_bot: Ops alert OPR-2026-441 created  (severity: medium).

ben: Infra note: provisioning blocked by residency flag. We can enable a 72h trial override with CS+AE+legal signoff: POST /internal/overrides {"org":"kitefin","override":"region_eu_trial","ttl":259200}.

maria: Comms plan draft:
- Now: Sam to notify customer and offer US demo fallback.
- 1h: AE Tom to confirm contract/residency addendum path.
- 4h: Ben to stage sandbox override for test if legal ok.
- 24-48h: Enable full EU trial once legal signs; run enablement session; update CRM (mark at-risk).

elaine: Customer open to 72h override if we guarantee no EU production data processed. Wants enablement before trial ends.

tom: I'll loop legal and finance, CR id KITE-2026-9001.

ben: Sandbox override tested and works. Won't push prod until signoff.

maria: Owner: maria. Actions: tom (legal), ben (override), sam/elaine (customer comms). Marking renewal at-risk and leaving thread open until post-session CRM update.
